task: slugify('Crème Brûlée') returns 'cr-me-br-l-e' instead of 'creme-brulee'. Accented letters should become their plain ASCII equivalents. Fix it so the test suite passes.
paginate(items, 1, 10) returns items 11-20 instead of the first ten. Fix the pagination bug so the tests pass.
parseDuration('500ms') throws a SyntaxError even though milliseconds are a supported unit. Fix it so the tests pass.
deepMerge modifies the target object passed to it, which corrupts shared default config. It should return a new object and leave its inputs untouched. Fix it so the tests pass.
Security report: merging untrusted JSON with deepMerge lets a '__proto__' key change the prototype of the result. Make deepMerge ignore prototype keys so the tests pass.
The LRU cache evicts entries that were just read with get(). Reading an entry should count as using it. Fix the cache so the tests pass.
formatMoney(1.005) returns '$1.00' but should round half up to '$1.01'. Fix the rounding so the tests pass.

parseCsv does not support quoted fields yet. Add support for double-quoted fields (commas and newlines inside quotes, and "" as an escaped quote), and throw a SyntaxError for an unterminated quote, so the tests pass.
